argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge-R69-OBSERVABILITY-20261014-GPT6'
$sha='03e8ec94e59ef4efbb748afed418eafada844add'
if(([string](& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)).Trim() -ne $sha){throw 'R69_SOURCE_MOVED'}
$node=(Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$script=Join-Path $root 'app\r69-viewer-bootstrap.js'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script)){throw 'STARTUP_SCRIPT_MISSING'}
$startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $startup)){throw 'STARTUP_DIR_MISSING'}
$link=Join-Path $startup 'WebAIBridge-R69-Live.lnk'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $link){throw 'STARTUP_LINK_EXISTS_REFUSE_OVERWRITE'}
$probe=& $node $script --status 2>&1
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('VIEWER_NOT_READY '+($probe|Out-String).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(150,($probe|Out-String).Length)))}
$reading=$probe|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json
if($reading.state -ne 'RUNNING' -or $reading.healthy -ne $true){throw 'CURRENT_VIEWER_NOT_HEALTHY'}
$w=New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$shortcut=$w.CreateShortcut($link)
$shortcut.TargetPath=$node
$shortcut.Arguments='"'+$script+'" --start'
$shortcut.WorkingDirectory=(Join-Path $root 'app')
$shortcut.WindowStyle=7
$shortcut.Description='Read-only WebAIBridge R69 live viewer at localhost:17450; idempotent on login'
$shortcut.Save()
$check=$w.CreateShortcut($link)
if($check.TargetPath -ne $node -or $check.Arguments -ne ('"'+$script+'" --start')){throw 'SHORTCUT_FAILED_VALIDATION'}
Write-Output 'AUTOSTART_INSTALLED=True'
Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA='+$sha)
Write-Output ('VIEWER_CURRENT_STATE='+$reading.state)
Write-Output ('VIEWER_RESTART_REQUIRED=False')
Write-Output ('STARTUP_SHORTCUT=WebAIBridge-R69-Live.lnk')
Write-Output ('VIEWER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:17450/')
Write-Output ('PROD_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
